description: 2026 Community Outreach cumulative figures supplied by the project owner on 2026-10-01, stated as 'till August 17, 2026'. This is a year-to-date coverage-range baseline (2026-01-01 to 2026-08-17), not monthly data: no monthly values are inferred and no programme records are created from it. A trailing '+' in the source is a lower bound and is kept as the AT_LEAST qualifier. The thematic and audience tables are stored with the meaning the source supports (see each metric's note); no gender figures were supplied. Approved programme data for months that start after the coverage end may extend the year-to-date total; months that overlap the coverage are never added to it.
